definition: חֶפְצִיבָֿהּ proper name, feminine ( my delight is in her ; compare Phoenician חפצבעל ) — 1. mother of king Manasseh 2Kgs 21:1 . 2. figurative name of Zion Isa 62:4 , here explained by כִּי חפץ יהוה בָּךְ for Yahweh delighteth in thee .
definition_html:
BDB3010 [H2657]

BDB3009 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB3011

חֶפְצִיבָֿהּ proper name, feminine (my delight is in her; compare Phoenician חפצבעל) —

1. mother of king Manasseh 2Kgs 21:1.
2. figurative name of Zion Isa 62:4, here explained by כִּי חפץ יהוה בָּךְ for Yahweh delighteth in thee.
